The post pays Rs.40000/- per month and is open to candidates with a Masters' degree carrying 55% marks and 3 years' museum experience. Applying takes two steps: submit the online form by 30 November 2026, then post the hard copy so that it reaches the University by 7 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: About DHSGSU
content_sections.text: Dr. Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya is a Central University at Sagar, Madhya Pradesh. This engagement is in its Department of Ancient Indian History, Culture & Archaeology.

content_sections.heading: DHSGSU Curator Vacancy Details 2026

content_sections.heading: DHSGSU Curator Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit is 40 years. Age, qualifications and experience are counted as on the last date of application. Relaxations are provided as per the existing Govt. of India / UGC policy. Candidates must meet one of these two routes: Masters' degree with 55% marks in Museology / History of Art from a recognized University or equivalent. Masters' degree with 55% marks in Ancient Indian History / Sanskrit / Pali / Prakrit / Persian / Arabic / Archaeology / Anthropology / Fine Arts or equivalent or other allied subjects from a recognized University, with a diploma/certificate in Museology of a recognized Institution. 3 years' experience in a Museum of National or Regional importance under the control of Central/State Govt. or Union Territory. This must include one year of practical experience in collection, conservation/preservation and exhibition of art objects. Research experience in a Museum of published research work. Practical training and experience in the relevant field. Check the official notification (PDF) for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

rows.event: Hard copy must reach the University

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Screening: a Screening Committee devises its own criteria to scrutinize applications and restrict the number of candidates called for interview. Interview: meeting the minimum qualification alone does not entitle a candidate to a call. Call letters go to eligible candidates by email only, and no TA/DA is paid for attending. Candidates must bring all original certificates of age, qualifications and experience. A candidate who fails to produce them may not be allowed to appear, and the candidature may be cancelled. The University may draw a panel as a waiting list. If a candidate higher on merit regrets to join or leaves after joining, the offer may go to the next candidate on merit, with the approval of the Competent Authority. The University also reserves the right to fill or not to fill the post.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on contract basis for a period not exceeding 12 months. It confers no right to claim regular employment in the University under any circumstances. The terms are sent in an Offer of Engagement. If they are not accepted within the stipulated time, the offer is treated as withdrawn. A duly stamped Contract Agreement is executed between the University and the employee at the time of recruitment. The person appointed is governed by the Rules/Regulations of the University. The engagement stays provisional until the character and antecedents reports are received, and an unsatisfactory report leads to cancellation or termination. The selected candidate must produce a certificate from the Medical Board issued by a Govt. Hospital/Board. False information, fake documents or canvassing lead to disqualification or cancellation, even after engagement.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DHSGSU Curator Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the DHSGSU online application portal , which is live from 1 November 2026, and fill in the form. Upload all necessary documents and certificates. An application incomplete in any respect is not considered. Take a hard copy of the online application form and attach the self-attested testimonials, certificates/educational qualifications and all supporting documents. Place everything in a closed envelope and mark it "Speed Post / Registered Post", with the Advt. No. and the post applied for. Address it to: The Assistant Registrar (Recruitment Cell), Dr. Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya, Sagar (M.P.) - 470003, India. Under "From", write your name, full address and mobile number. Send it by Speed Post or Registered Post only. An application that fails to reach the University in time is rejected, and the University is not responsible for postal delay. Candidates already in service should apply through proper channel.

faq.question: Q1. Is the online application enough for the DHSGSU Curator post?
faq.answer: No. The hard copy of the online form, with self-attested documents, must also reach the Assistant Registrar (Recruitment Cell) by 6.00 P.M. on 7 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. I applied under the 2025 Curator advertisement. Do I need to apply again?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates who applied against Advt. No. R/NT/2025/01 dated 14.01.2025 must apply afresh online. They need not pay any fee, but must give the details of the earlier fee and upload a copy of the fee receipt to get the waiver.

faq.question: Q3. Can I apply with a Masters' degree in History or Archaeology?
faq.answer: Masters' candidates in Archaeology, Ancient Indian History and the other listed or allied subjects need 55% marks and also a diploma/certificate in Museology of a recognized Institution. That diploma/certificate is not asked for with a Masters' in Museology or History of Art.

faq.question: Q4. What kind of museum experience is required?
faq.answer: The 3 years must be in a Museum of National or Regional importance under Central/State Govt. or Union Territory control. One of those years must be practical experience in collection, conservation/preservation and exhibition of art objects.

faq.question: Q5. On what date will my age be counted?
faq.answer: Age is counted as on the last date of application, and the upper limit is 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the Curator engagement?
faq.answer: It runs for a period not exceeding 12 months, purely on contract basis.

faq.question: Q7. How will I know if I am called for the interview?
faq.answer: The University sends call letters to eligible candidates by email only, and it is not responsible for lost email or communication caused by a wrong address given by the candidate.

faq.question: Q8. Where will changes to this advertisement be published?
faq.answer: Amendments, if any, are published only on the University website, www.dhsgsu.edu.in.
